The final summary:

**Completed Work:**
- **[R1]** Added `maxsplit` (keyword-only) to `sliced`, `split_after`, `split_at`, `split_before`, and `split_when` — all correctly limit splits when specified.
- **[R2]** Added `keep_separator` (keyword-only, default=False) to `split_at` — separator items are included in preceding chunk when True.
- **[R3]** Created `UnequalIterablesError` exception class and `zip_equal` function — raises the error when iterables have different lengths. Both exported in `__all__`.
- **[R4]** Verified `stagger` handles edge cases correctly (empty iterables, single elements, negative/positive offsets, longest=True, generator exceptions). No code changes needed.

**Test Results:** All 389 existing tests pass (315 in test_more.py, 74 in test_recipes.py).

**Files Modified:**
- `more_itertools/more.py` — Added new functions, parameters, and exports
- `more_itertools/more.pyi` — Updated type stubs
- `STATUS.json` — Written with probability scores (0.95 for each requirement)
